title: 1 Florin - Victoria (1st portrait; 'Gothic' type)

obverse.description: Crowned bust of Queen Victoria left, legend and date around.
obverse.unabridged_legend: Victoria Dei Gratia Britanniarum Regina Fidei Defensatrix mdccclxxvii
obverse.lettering_translation: Victoria by the Grace of God Queen of the Britains Defender of the Faith 1877

reverse.description: Crowned cruciform shields of England, Scotland and Ireland, national flower emblems in angles, legend around.
reverse.lettering:
One florin
one tenth of a pound

comments:
The standard weight of these coins was 4/11 troy ounce (174.5 grains).

Obverse die varieties:

KM#746.1, Sp#3891 (1851-63) Type B1 - reads 'brit:', WW below bust, no die number;
KM#746.3, Sp#3892 (1864-67) Type B2 - similar as last but die number below bust;
KM#746.2, Sp#3893 (1868-79) Type B3 - similar as last but reads 'britt:' ;
KM#746.2, Sp#3894 (1877 only) Type B4 - similar as last but border of 48 arcs, no WW below bust;
KM#746.2, Sp#3895 (1877-78) Type B5 - similar as last but border of 42 arcs;
KM#746.4, Sp#3897 (1877-79) Type B6 - similar reads 'britt:', WW, no die number, border of 48 arcs;
KM#746.4, Sp#3898 (1879 only) Type B7 - similar as last but no WW, border of 38 arcs;
KM#746.4, Sp#3900 (1880-87) Type B8 - similar as last but younger portrait, border of 34 arcs;
KM#746.4, Sp#3901 (1887 only) Type B9 - similar as last but border of 46 arcs;
